clips.title: The story
paras: Keeper Albagorm seeks help for the Charred Vale from far to the south. The Bloodfury harpies have been driven back for now, but the wounded land needs more than force to heal.

The Charred Vale lies beneath ash in southern Stonetalon Mountains, scarred by terrible destruction. Alliance forces under Keeper Albagorm have driven the Bloodfury harpies from their nests in the ruins, but their retreat may not last. Albagorm knows that force can only hold the harpies back. The ravaged earth must be healed before they return and take the Vale again.

The grove tenders need help beyond their own means to restore the scorched land. Albagorm sends you south, past the salt flats and canyons of Thousand Needles, to Thalanaar on the border of Feralas. Falfindel Waywarder waits there. The night elf druid is known for a rare gift: calling on ancient forest spirits to bring life back to dead soil.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Bloodfuries have been subdued. But they will regroup soon enough if action is not taken.

Far south of the Barrens lies a land known as Thousand Needles. If you travel west in Thousand Needles until you reach the lush forest's edge of Feralas, you will find a druid named Falfindel Waywarder.
This great and wise druid is capable of calling forth great forest spirits which can aid in the reclamation of the Charred Vale.
Send word of our need! Seek him out at once!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Keeper Albagorm was wise to send you with such urgency.
Let us see if we cannot call forth aid from the great forest to travel to the Charred Vale before it is too late.
